description: When a Stage 4->5 push sequence rapidly pushes a bookkeeping commit, a clean 'sync: merge target' commit (whose CI run gets cancelled), and a follow-up 1-parent bookkeeping commit ('stage 5 carry-over'), both ci_bookkeeping_gate.py and ci_merge_push_gate.py miss the skip fast-path because the head commit is a 1-parent commit stacked on a cancelled merge commit, forcing a full 7-12 minute CI run on unchanged PR code.
goal: Extend scripts/ci_merge_push_gate.py, scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py, and scripts/ci_bookkeeping_chain.py so a synchronize push whose head is a bookkeeping-only commit chain stacked on a clean two-parent base-branch merge commit (even when intermediate bookkeeping or merge CI runs were cancelled rather than skipped) evaluates the combined chain from the last real green PR head through the clean merge to head_sha, verifying every single-parent step before and after the merge touched only bookkeeping paths, the merge itself satisfies all existing clean-merge, overlap, config, relation, and base-branch real-success rules, and hygiene jobs are never skipped. Add hermetic tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ci_merge_push_gate.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_gate.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_chain.py (using apps/sandbox-executor/tests/ci_bookkeeping_fakes.py) covering cancelled intermediate bookkeeping+merge chains, mixed non-bookkeeping changes after the merge (must run full CI), and hygiene never skipped. Keep every modified module within its existing line budget and never modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Preserving the merge-push fast-path across stacked bookkeeping commits eliminates 7-12 minutes of redundant Stage 5 CI wait per target-syncing pull request without weakening any safety invariant.
acceptance_criteria: `ci_merge_push_gate.py` skips heavy CI when a clean `sync: merge target` + bookkeeping commit chain preserves an unchanged PR-own diff against a green prior head and green `origin/main` commit.
Hermetic tests cover the combined merge+bookkeeping push case; `uv run pytest` passes.

Non-bookkeeping changes anywhere in the chain or any hygiene job always force a full CI run, and all modified modules stay within existing line budgets without touching holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.

All changes remain within the declared scope (scripts/ci_merge_push_gate.py, scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py, scripts/ci_bookkeeping_chain.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/ci_bookkeeping_fakes.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ci_merge_push_gate.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_gate.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_chain.py), uv run task lint passes, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
